save.text: Subscriber giveaway at 4,200 won by LL1973 (signed PHB + signed cast photo).
No Critical Role next week due to San Diego Comic-Con; panels at PetCo Park Thurs (Geek & Sundry 1-2, Critical Role 4-5) and panel will be streamed later.
Matt and Marisha traveling to New Zealand following Comic-Con causing two-week hiatus for main-story; other cast will stream alternate content.
Intro video malfunction during live show; cast improvised and proceeded to start game. (confirmed by Matt, turns 75,110,124)

They are on a skyship crossing the Ozmit Sea toward Vasselheim/Othanzia carrying the Horn of Orcus sealed in a holy container; recent battle with wyvern/griffin-riding bandits, party took a captive. (summary by Matt, turns 130-139)
Travel time: originally ~6 days across ocean; currently a few days into journey and still airborne. (Matt, turns 144-146)

They are on a skyship crossing the Ozmit Sea toward Vasselheim/Othanzia carrying the Horn of Orcus sealed in a holy container; a captive halfling mage saved by the party is bound in the ship's anti-magic brig (captain ordered) after attacking crew. (confirmed by Matt, turns 151-161, 155)
Party spent several days traveling; spells have recovered. Percy reading; days passed without incident. (Matt, turns 167, 224-227)

Grog (Travis) used a beard-growth attempt: roll succeeded partially (38%), produced thin, translucent stubble; party braided it and added beads/flowers; Percy (Liam) glued frayed rope goatee onto Grog while he slept and others reacted—Perception check with disadvantage requested. (roll 38 at turn 181; events turns 197-211, 230-236)
Grog's goatee is now a glorious dark brown, well-braided, mildly frayed, ~3–4 inches long; Grog proud and shows it off. (confirmed by Matt & Travis, turns 238-244)
Weather on sixth day: sky grows cloudy and colder; clouds slow-forming (likely natural cold weather, not arcane). (confirmed by Matt & Marisha, turns 245-251)
Tiberius (Orion) successfully convinced Scanlan to trade the circlet for his Ioun Stone; Scanlan agreed. (confirmed by Orion & Scanlan, turns 257-315)
It began snowing while on the skyship; temperature noticeably chillier (Matt, turn 350).
Keyleth (Marisha) mentions Fire Ashari live in/near Pyrah in Vasselheim area and are her sister tribe; she may visit them after handling the Horn (Marisha, turns 356,372).

Ashari tribe structure: members seek elemental bleed points; Aramente is a once-in-a-generation trial to become a headmaster; last person to undertake Aramente didn't return (Marisha, turns 366,400-402).

Keyleth's mother left when Keyleth was ~5–6; Keyleth barely remembers her and doesn't know if she's alive. Party intends to visit Keyleth's Ashari/sister tribe when in Vasselheim/Othanzia and may ask about her. (confirmed by Marisha, turns 408–456)

Land sighted: Othanzia (continent) approaching; Vesper Timberland (dark forest with light snowfall) visible; singular mountain spire ~20–30 miles inland with a densely built, highly fortified city at its base—walls layered, mix of ancient and newer construction, topped with dragon-headed ballistae. Kima identified and commented. (confirmed by Matt, turns 457–473)
Party descending toward a heavily fortified city in Othanzia; city appears built to withstand sieges (walls, ballistae). (confirmed by Matt, turns 466–476)
Crew preparing to lower ropes and a crane to disembark; Trinket to be lowered via crane; Kima appears anxious about the city approach and offers to answer questions (observed, turns 543-544).
Ship docks on a flattened mill platform adapted for skyships; escorts expected to meet them to guide where to take the Horn (observed, turns 477,546).
Scanlan stores a 3rd-level Lightning Bolt into the Ioun Stone (stone is white but glows greenish-blue); spell slot expended but energy stored for after rest (confirmed by Matt, turns 526-528,538).
Kima last with Order 'proper' eight years ago; she'll meet them now (Matt, turns 557-563).
Scalebearer Yonn identified as a devoted, not-deceptive escort; addressed as Scalebearer Yonn (Matt, turns 568-571,599-600,619).
Platinum Sanctuary ~25-minute walk from dock/platform; escorts will guide party to dispose of the Horn; few in city know of Horn—only Kima, party, and Highbearer Vord (Matt, turns 585-589,607-613).
Vasselheim called 'cradle of faith/Dawn City'; pilgrimage by foot; visible holy symbols on guards (Matt, turn 635).
Scalebearer Yonn leads party into city; cautions about open Alter Self use in public (Matt & Orion, turns 661,659).

Party plans tactical dispersion: some rooftop overwatch (Vex & Percy), Keyleth eagle form for aerial support, others flank on path; Tiberius staying rear blending with crowd; stealth checks made (players, turns 665-707,690-696).
Vasselheim is ancient 'cradle of faith'; arcane use is publicly profane and tightly controlled; citizens hardy and view living there as devotion. (observed/confirmed by Matt, turn 717)

Party carries the platinum box that held the Horn (~1.5–2 ft square, solid platinum/silver with sapphires and intricate engravings); people notice it but don't gawk. (observed/confirmed by Matt & players, turns 725-738)

Approach to Platinum Sanctuary: 15–20 minute staircase ascent; fortress built into mountain with silver Draconic inscriptions (Bahamut shield/dragon emblem); three ivory/silver spires on top; massive marble doors open as Scalebearers approach. (observed/confirmed by Matt, turns 743-758)
City militia called 'Bastions'—volunteer civilian militia comprising ~25% populace; wear makeshift armor; patrol staircases and use ballista. (Matt, turn 770-774, 815)
Envoys are distinct from temple Scalebearers; envoys wear blue/silver robes from Bahamut temple; Scalebearers wear different armor. (Matt, turn 772)

Keyleth (as eagle) saw multiple large, fast serpentine forms moving in the forest ~1/4 mile away; ballista fired and creatures retreated—seems a common occurrence. (Marisha, Matt, turns 804,809-819,815)
Keyleth (Marisha) briefly arrested/cuffed in the Platinum Sanctuary but released when Kima identified her; Scalebearers embarrassed and escorted off. (turns 852-894)
Main chamber/temple interior: plain stone fortress, ancient smell, humming with divine energy—Pike senses strong holy presence (temple 'goes to six'). (turns 910-923)
Kima asserts authority when Keyleth is arrested: 'She's with me.' Scalebearers apologize to 'Lady Kima' and quickly remove cuffs. (turns 882-886)

Main chamber/temple interior: domed Platinum Sanctuary (approx 80 ft high) with ancient fresco depicting creation and Bahamut battling multi-headed Tiamat; Highbearer Vord greets party and confirms the box contains one of the Horns of Orcus; Kima bows as disciple. (turns 934-974)
Platinum Sanctuary entrance: Scalebearer Yonn used holy symbol to open inner double doors with Bahamut sigil; central worship chamber opens. (turn 934)

Highbearer Vord: slender old elven male in white robes with Bahamut emblem; cautions not to open the container; divine glow interacts with the box which pulses then vanishes (confirming the object's nature). (turns 962-972)

Highbearer Vord explains the Star of Exaltation (a Bahamut relic) was used/destroyed ~300 years ago during a siege; the vault chamber below is maintained but lower chambers now infested with subterranean spider creatures; a Scalebearer (Yonn) fled after triggering some defenses. Scalebearers will escort the party and bring the platinum box into the vault; full defenses can be triggered and would alert temple. (turns 979-1031)

Yonn (Scalebearer) prepared lower vault but fled when he encountered subterranean spiders and initiated some defenses; he remains employed due to long service/seniority despite being addled. (turns 979-997)
Highbearer Vord confirms the temple is well-guarded under Bahamut's gaze; if the vault's full defenses trigger nothing will reach the inner chamber unannounced. (turns 1026-1031)
Laura used Primeval Awareness; detected no dragons within six-mile radius of city. (turn 1050-1052)

Highbearer Vord/temple offers party 3,000 gp total to seal/deliver the Horn; Kima objects but party accepts after persuasion/deception checks (Sam rolled 30; Laura 19). Reward given 'once artifact is delivered and sealed.' (turns 1093-1127)
Kima accompanies party to the temple vault; led down two layers into an old musty storage basement to secure the Horn. (turns 1130-1140)
Storage area under temple has five ceremonial-armor guards; Kima uses holy symbol in a wall recess to dispel wood illusion revealing stone doorway and stair. (Matt, turn 1141-1146)

Descending stair leads to 50x50 ft chamber, ~20 ft high, filled with white mist produced by two dragon-carved pillars whose mouths emit mist; pillars' bases have slight gaps indicating they can pivot. Mist refills quickly; Gust of Wind cleared center briefly. (Matt, turns 1160-1176,1186-1190,1173-1174)
Party debated reassigning communication earrings; proposed recipients Vax, Grog, and Scanlan. (Orion/party, turns 1193-1201)
Keyleth (as caster) used Gust/mist spell twice to clear a path; first cast partially broken by shoulder triggering flames; second cast cleared mist allowing group to pass. (turns 1215,1298-1305)

Dragon-mouths in room erupted into fiery flames when mist was breached; caused area fire attack: Vax & Tiberius avoided damage (12 each on failed?); Scanlan, Keyleth, and Pike took 24 fire damage; Percy, Grog, Vex, Trinket were behind and observed. (turns 1235-1277,1286)

Party split while moving: front group (Keyleth, Scanlan, Tiberius, Pike) ran through and were hit by flames; others (Percy, Grog, Vex, Trinket) remained behind; Scalebearers accompanied party through after mist cleared. (turns 1266-1277,1292-1295,1305)

Party navigated a cylindrical chamber with multiple piston-like pressure-plate pillars that spin/piston into ceiling; Vax triggered them, took 40 crushing damage to shoulder blade but survived (turns 1322-1376,1379).
Vex fired a Light-imbued arrow to reveal room layout (turn 1326-1327).
Vax used Boots of Haste and Luck to aid acrobatics; succeeded multiple checks (natural 20 used, final acrobatics 23) (turns 1344-1351,1357,1382-1385).
Room is a rotating grinding mill with pistons/pillars slamming into ceiling; there is a small quarter-sized hole in ceiling visible intermittently where a pillar retracts. (turn 1401-1406)
Vex (Laura) successfully shot an arrow into that hole with advantage/inspiration, total attack roll 35; arrow narrowly passed as pillars slammed. (turns 1469-1472,1470)
Tiberius (Orion) responded by casting Telekinesis immediately after the arrow release to swoop it up. (turn 1473)

Vex (Laura) shot arrow into ceiling hole with advantage/inspiration, attack total 35; arrow initially passed but was later telekinetically manipulated and then slammed/ricocheted into the slit, splintering metal and disgorging metal chunks. (turns 1469-1473,1473-1485)

Tiberius (Orion) attempted Telekinesis immediately after arrow release; rolled a d20+5 = 17 to interact with the arrow; his effect slammed the arrow harder into the slit causing splintering and metal grinding. (turns 1473,1481-1484)
Party paused for a short rest after the room event; players used hit dice (Vax and others) and the stream took a five-minute break. (turns 1510-1523)

GameChanger charity segment: Taylor (guest) described founding GameChanger after personal illness; organization provides games, hospital visits, scholarships; campaign with Deus Ex offers game copy for donations > $1; Critical Role pledged tonight's donations to GameChanger (turns 1556-1566,1579-1586,1598-1601,1610-1611).
Website/link: gamechangercharity.org hosts Deus Ex campaign; donations > $1 grant a director's cut copy (turn 1562,1598).

Logistics: Mods/chat have GameChanger command/link; donations tonight routed to GameChanger via 826LA link; site briefly crashed due to traffic; cast noted limited time to read messages due to flights (turns 1578-1581,1607-1611,1597).
